Before you book

Clear from the
first message.

Your enquiry starts a conversation—it does not reserve a time. The studio confirms the scope, price, date and deposit before a booking becomes final.

01

Request a time

Send the service, preferred date, deadline and track count. We’ll confirm what is available.

02

Confirm the scope

Recording starts at one hour and sessions run up to eight hours. Extra work is agreed before it begins.

03

Secure the booking

A 25% deposit secures a confirmed slot. Rescheduling and deposit treatment are confirmed in writing before payment.

04

Review the work

Two revisions are included. The standard maximum turnaround is 48 hours once the required files and direction are ready.

Good to know

Questions before
the session.

Can I bring my own beat?

Yes. Bring the highest-quality file available and make sure you have permission to record and release music over it.

What should I send for mixing?

Send each track from the same start point, plus your rough mix and one or two reference songs. We’ll confirm the preferred file format before work starts.

Can I book mastering without mixing?

Yes. Send an approved stereo WAV with enough headroom and no limiter unless the studio asks for a reference-limited version too.

Does submitting the form confirm my session?

No. It opens a prepared WhatsApp message. Your booking is confirmed only after the studio agrees the date, scope, price and deposit.

How do revisions and turnaround work?

Two revisions are included and the standard maximum turnaround is 48 hours once all required files and direction are received. Larger edits or new creative direction may need a separate quote.
